description: Works backward from E-benzalacetone and a biaryl beta-hydroxy ester to plausible starting materials, then tests the crossed-aldol, Suzuki coupling and ester-enolate addition routes forward. Compares competing reactions, route order, illustrative yields, racemate versus single-enantiomer targets, and analytical verification.
